snippet.title: TRT World
snippet.description:
At TRT World we're building a global community focused around change. We’re looking beyond the headlines to drive meaningful conversations that empower. We want to connect people across the globe to issues that matter. We explore the reality behind the hashtags and the people behind the statistics. We will seek to unpack the issues behind each story.

By placing the human at the heart of each story we hope to promote a global conscience that provokes moral reactions - revealing a deeper understanding of the diversity of the lives around us.

Subscribe to our channel for all our latest in-depth, on the ground reporting from around the world.

snippet.title: Danny Cheek
snippet.description: I love teaching people how to understand personal finance. There are many complicated things in the financial world that many large companies will say it's very hard to understand when in reality they can be explained much easier. Whether it be the stock market, credit cards, banking, or anything else finance-related, I love explaining it out and trying to help people figure things out so they can further improve their financial life. I plan on uploading a few times a month talking about how to manage credit, stocks, and banking. I have been teaching students in the classroom for many years on these topics and I believe that online I can spread my message further.

snippet.title: Historyawn
snippet.description:
Historyawn is a quiet corner of YouTube where history and economics turn into gentle bedtime stories. Here, complex ideas become soft, slow-paced narratives designed to help you unwind, learn a little, and drift peacefully into sleep.

You’ll hear calm explanations of everything from inflation, recessions, bubbles, and trade, to broader moments in world history and the long journey of economic development. No stress, no jargon, no prior knowledge needed—just cozy storytelling and soothing background narration.

If you enjoy falling asleep to soft-spoken learning, peaceful historical rambles, or relaxing explorations of how people, markets, and civilizations evolved, you’re in the right place.
Close your eyes, get comfortable, and let history… yawn.

Sweet dreams.

Subscribe and get smarter about the economy, one juice-box-level explanation at a time.
